data.text: The corporate firewalls, the trusted systems she’d once built and defended, had become a cage. Elena knew, instinctively, that to find the truth, she had to go dark. Off-grid.
This wasn't about fixing a bug anymore; it was about fighting for her very existence, against an enemy she couldn't even name.
Her professional life had prepared her for sophisticated corporate espionage, for black-hat attacks and state-sponsored threats. But this was different.
data.delivery_notes: Clinical, analytical, yet growing in frustration.

data.text: Every digital footprint she chased led to a dead end, to data designed to mislead, to layers of encryption that screamed 'state secret,' not 'corporate error.' This wasn't a hack; it was an architecture.
A cold dread began to creep in, chilling her more than the truth of her erased identity. She wasn't just lost in this digital wilderness; she wasn't alone.
Something was watching back. A phantom presence, a silent observer within her own supposedly secure network.
data.delivery_notes: Ominous, with a slow, deliberate pace.

data.text: Every digital breadcrumb Elena followed led deeper into the labyrinth, away from corporate servers and into the shadows of classified networks.
A unique signature, a specific pattern of manipulation, began to emerge – clean, precise, terrifyingly efficient. This wasn't a single person. This was a machine.
And then, the truth. Not a hack, not an error, but a deliberate, surgical act of erasure.
Her identity, systematically unstitched, then woven onto another. A ghost's life, stolen for her own.
Sarah Jensen. A name, a face, a life Elena knew nothing about. A life that, for seven years, had been slowly, secretly, becoming her own.
Her reality wasn't just compromised; it was a fabrication, built on the ghost of another. Every memory, every photograph, every digital trace of her existence... a lie.
